description:

#Shorts #stocks #investing
pinned_comment: Which company would you want a tiny slice of?

beats.line: Your stocks lose money about 1 year in 3. Why hold them 15 years?
Zorb looked closer. A stock is a tiny slice of a real company.
Companies sell those slices to raise money.
They pay off debt, build things and launch new products.
Earthlings call the slices equities. Fancy word, same slice.
But stock prices move down as well as up.
If the company goes bankrupt, bondholders get paid first.
Common stockholders go last. They may get nothing.
So why do Earthlings keep holding on?
Investors who stuck it out for long periods generally got rewarded.
But the losing years keep coming back.
